prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1437; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision that occurred when a vehicle insured under your policy struck our client's vehicle broadside at an intersection. Our client has suffered significant physical injuries and is now receiving medical treatment, and the full extent of those injuries and related losses is still being determined.

Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to this office and do not contact our client directly. Within the next fourteen days, please provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits, and disclose any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your insured, your company, and any agents or adjusters working on this matter preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file materials, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from either vehicle. Please confirm in writing that a litigation hold has been placed on these materials.
